title: Systematic Multi-Agent Vision-and-Language Navigation: Formulation, Benchmark, and Method
abstract: arXiv:2609.35965v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) has largely focused on a single agent following a single instruction, yet many real-world applications require teams of robots to tackle tasks beyond the capabilities of any individual agent. We present Systematic Multi-Agent Vision-and-Language Navigation, providing, to our knowledge, the first systematic formalization of multi-agent VLN as a constrained coordination problem: each mission consists of subtasks carrying dependency and resource constraints (presence locks and holding chains). A verified four-stage crafting pipeline instantiates the task as MAVLN, comprising 11,724 episodes across 145 scenes with teams of up to four agents under three instruction regimes, accompanied by tailored constraint-aware metrics. We further present TRISS, a coordination-ready navigation system coupling an LLM-based subtask scheduler, a shared topological memory that turns each agent's exploration into team know

translated_title: 系统化多智能体视觉语言导航：形式化、基准与方法
translated_abstract: 视觉语言导航（VLN）的研究大多集中于单一智能体遵循单一指令的场景，然而许多现实世界的应用需要机器人团队协作完成超出任何单个智能体能力范围的任务。我们提出了系统化多智能体视觉语言导航，据我们所知，这是首次将多智能体VLN系统地形式化为一个受限协调问题：每个任务由携带依赖关系和资源约束（存在锁与持有链）的子任务组成。一个经过验证的四阶段构建流程将该任务实例化为MAVLN基准，涵盖145个场景中的11,724个回合，团队规模最多支持四个智能体，并包含三种指令模式，同时配备了专门的约束感知评估指标。我们进一步提出了TRISS——一个面向协调的导航系统，它将基于大语言模型（LLM）的子任务调度器与共享拓扑记忆相结合，后者能够将每个智能体的探索转化为团队知识。
tldr: 该论文首次将多智能体视觉语言导航系统化形式化为带有依赖与资源约束的协调问题，构建了包含145个场景、11,724个回合的MAVLN基准，并提出结合LLM子任务调度器与共享拓扑记忆的TRISS导航系统。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first systematic formalization of multi-agent vision-and-language navigation as a constrained coordination problem, introduces the MAVLN benchmark with 11,724 episodes across 145 scenes for teams of up to four agents, and proposes TRISS, a coordination-ready navigation system coupling an LLM-based subtask scheduler with a shared topological memory.
